meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装好后,当你要把 NanoClaw v1 迁到 v2 时,Claude 会先确认迁移脚本是否已运行,然后接手收尾:设置所有者、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置等,最后验证并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration”等关键词,或要求完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移时触发。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: Claude 会检查迁移状态并开始收尾。

say.text: 迁移脚本已经跑完了,继续收尾吧
say.note: Claude 会读取迁移记录并继续。

say.text: 检查一下迁移进度,把剩下的做完
say.note: Claude 会完成剩余的所有步骤。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask to migrate NanoClaw v1 to v2, Claude checks if the script ran, then sets the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, etc., and verifies/restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration", or ask to complete a v1-to-v2 migration.

say_en.text: Help me finish the migration from v1 to v2.
say_en.note: Claude will check migration status and start wrapping up.

say_en.text: The migration script has already run, let's continue.
say_en.note: Claude will read the handoff and resume.

say_en.text: Check the migration progress and finish the rest.
say_en.note: Claude will complete all remaining steps.
